question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 21 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The flash sale campaign went live, causing a sudden increase in request volume and error rate.
why_chain: The flash sale campaign triggered a spike in user activity in ap-south.
This spike led to a higher request volume and error rate.
The increased load caused the p95 latency to rise.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The deployment of search v1.26 caused the change.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment was in eu-west, not ap-south.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The typo on the help page caused the change.
ruled_out.reason: The help page typo occurred 244 minutes before the change.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for region ap-south rose from 137 ms to 243 ms (+78%), with a change point at 2026-03-21T10:25:00Z.
The change is concentrated in region ap-south: 4 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for region ap-south rose (1233 per 5 min before, 4638 per 5 min after, +276%).
At the same time, error rate for region ap-south rose (0.35% before, 0.75% after, +114%).
Marketing: flash sale campaign goes live in ap-south at 10:25 UTC (ap-south; 191 min before the change; record R014)
Request volume 3x normal in ap-south (ap-south; 12 min after the change; record R017)
autoscaler: scaling out, 4 new instances requested (ap-south; 20 min after the change; record R018)
Customer reports a typo on the help page. (auth, ap-south; 244 min before the change; record R012)
Deployed search v1.26 to eu-west (search, eu-west; 4 min before the change; record R016)

reasons: ✓ A change event (tickets) lines up in time (191 min before the change).
✓ 2 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume rose, as a traffic cause requires.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Implement a more aggressive autoscaler to handle sudden spikes in traffic.
Monitor request volume and error rate closely during marketing campaigns to identify and address sudden spikes in traffic.
Optimize the autoscaler configuration to better handle sudden traffic spikes.
